plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 135 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.20162, -121.99857, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 83 m, about 117 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 640 m SW of the spot at 544 m (58.19831, -122.09967). Water: unnamed wetland 100 m NE (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-48, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-48: about 832 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.12 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
